author: matthewkeil
content: I feel strongly that we need to focus on PQ as the utmost priority.  Anything that can potentially conflict, or cause issue with the PQ upgrades should be carefully weighed.  As an example decoupled consensus, will drastically affect timing considerations and should be implemented first before short slots.  Every development cycle that is spent on tuning shorter slots is developer time not focused on PQ.  There will be space in the roadmap over the coming forks to look at shorting slots, as its an important goal.  But it is not "urgent" whereas PQ is.  In particular I feel that it is definitely not "H* urgent"

author: matthewkeil
content: I also feel very strongly that a "light fork" for H* is prudent after a very long G* dev cycle.  FOCIL will be challenging enough and there are several other small maintenance EIPs that should prob get tackled.  Shortening slots is not just turning a knob like it would appear at first glance
